author: SGMC
body: It seems to me that in quite a few posts, the map makers say things like, "I build this on so-and-so's server" or "thanks to this person for supplying the server". Is there an avicus building server that is open to the public or something?
body_tagged: It seems to me that in quite a few posts, the map makers say things like, "I build this on so-and-so's server" or "thanks to this person for supplying the server". Is there an avicus building server that is open to the public or something?
title: Map Making Servers?

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
1 - alexanderjoe10 used to have one, however I'm not sure if it is still open.
2 - You can also try asking Steven5703 if you can use his server.
3 - Merlinmaster builds a lot of maps, so you could try asking him about the server IP and if it's open publicly to anyone.

replies.author: awesome_apricot
replies.body: I think I've said this before - it's not very hard to make a simple server.. Aslong as you've got a compatable router that's eZ to port forward.
replies.body_tagged: I think I've said this before - it's not very hard to make a simple server.. Aslong as you've got a compatable router that's eZ to port forward.

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
Actually, you don't even need to do that. Yes, that is how a server can be made, but you can also use a program called "Hamatchi" to make a server, which means that you don't have to port forward if you don't know how to do that.
Either way works, it's up to you.
